name: Naphish
title: Youngest son of Nahor
summary: Naphish was the youngest of the twelve sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, born to his wife Milcah. He became the ancestor of an Arab tribe later known as the Naphishites, mentioned in connection with the Ishmaelite and eastern tribes. His descendants played a role in the early history of the tribes in the Transjordan region.

siblings: Maacah, sister of Nahor and his concubine Reumah

keyEvents.title: Birth of Naphish mentioned
keyEvents.description: Naphish is mentioned as the twelfth and last son of Nahor and Milcah in a genealogical report brought to Abraham.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's family informed about Nahor's sons
keyEvents.description: After Abraham had passed the test of sacrificing Isaac, he was told that his brother Nahor had twelve sons, including Naphish.

keyEvents.title: Naphishites at war with eastern tribes
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Naphish, the Naphishites, are mentioned among the tribes that Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh fought against and defeated.

keyEvents.title: Naphishites among the defeated tribes
keyEvents.description: The Naphishites were defeated along with the Hagrites, Jetur, and Nodab, and the Israelites took their livestock and property.

keyEvents.title: Naphish in Ishmael's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: A tribe called Naphish is also mentioned in connection with the sons of Ishmael, which may indicate a connection or blending between the two lineages.
